settings.heading: Every score quotes the line of the CV it came from.
settings.lede: Recruitment screening for hiring teams. Drop a folder of CVs in, press one button, and get a ranked shortlist where every number is traceable to the candidate's own words. An AI agent extracts the facts. A deterministic engine does the arithmetic. A person decides — nothing auto-rejects.

settings.label: Evidence, not vibes
settings.value: The model returns facts and the quote each fact came from. Every score on the shortlist links back to the line of the CV that produced it.

settings.label: Arithmetic you can audit
settings.value: The language model never produces a number. A deterministic scoring engine is the only place a number is created, so two runs on the same CV give the same score.

settings.label: A failed requirement is a label, not a rejection
settings.value: Candidates who miss a requirement are flagged for a person to overrule. The full score and the full record are kept either way.

settings.label: It asks before it spends
settings.value: About 4.5p and 45 seconds per CV. It shows the count, the job advert and the cost before sending anything, and asks a second time above 80 CVs in one run.

settings.label: Every batch can be undone
settings.value: Undo removes an assessment, never a CV. A copy of whatever was removed is kept. Nothing is deleted by mistake.

settings.label: Roles and billing built in
settings.value: Owner, admin, member and viewer roles. Teammates join by invite. Trial, Starter, Team and Scale plans with hosted checkout.

settings.heading: Screening that a hiring manager, a candidate and a regulator can all read.

settings.label: Reject anyone automatically
settings.value: A failed requirement is a label a person can overrule, not a deletion.

settings.label: Guess whether a CV was written by AI
settings.value: Detectors misfire on roughly 61% of non-native English writers and show demographic bias. Using one would be a discrimination claim with the evidence already published.

settings.label: Score spelling, grammar, or which school someone attended
settings.value: Class and race proxies that look like merit.

settings.label: Count a career gap or penalise part-time work
settings.value: Gaps are shown to a human. They are never counted against anyone.

settings.label: Produce a number the model invented
settings.value: The model returns facts and quotes. The scoring engine does every calculation, and it is the only place a number is created.

settings.label: Leave the paperwork to you
settings.value: A data protection impact assessment, legitimate-interests assessment, record of processing and candidate notices ship with it.

settings.eyebrow: What it deliberately will not do
settings.heading: The constraints matter more than the feature list — and tests enforce them.

settings.title: Bring a job advert and a folder of CVs.
settings.desc: A 30-minute walkthrough on your own vacancy, with the cost shown before a single CV is read.

settings.title: Your reviews, with the same evidence trail.
settings.desc: Loculens reads every Google review across every branch, names the team members in them and drafts the replies you have not sent.

settings.heading: Shortlists you can defend to the candidate you did not hire.
